scientific_integrity: The five singular parameter values are taken from Catanese; node counts, node types, transversality, and discriminant multiplicities are independently derived here.
Finite code checks are supplementary to the symbolic proof and are not used as an infinite-search substitute.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the coordinate-sign/permutation symmetric pencil; no claim is made about a neighborhood in the full quartic moduli space.

The multiplicity 68 at the double quadric is determined from the global degree-108 discriminant after all other local multiplicities are established; no finer local primary decomposition there is claimed.
title: The discriminant profile of the Cefalù–Fermat quartic pencil
